note: Fund risk rules. risk_pct_per_trade: per-trade max-loss budget as a fraction of equity (scales as the account grows; the auto-trade also keeps its own hard $ cap, effective = min of the two). daily_loss_limit_pct: halt NEW entries once today's P&L is down this fraction of yesterday's close. max_drawdown_pct: halt NEW entries while equity is this far below its high-water mark (from Alpaca portfolio history). These are STARTING values for a small account — review and tune. Equity/P&L/HWM come from Alpaca (durable, restart-proof).
